changes: Added a runtime activity-root path for managed global-thin projects while keeping canonical config loading tied to lattice.config.json; wired cli-engine activity logging and Codex adapter global-thin detection to that helper; added regression smoke coverage.
usage: Run lattice codex verify from a managed global-thin project; the global fallback heartbeat now records session_brief activity to .lattice/activity.jsonl even when the project has only .lattice/lattice.json.
expectedOutcome: In solver-visible, lattice codex verify should pass Global fallback heartbeat and must not print no activity heartbeat for session.
actualTranscript: Live smoke in /Users/jek/Documents/Work/deepswe-pos-codex-gpt55-run/solver-visible exited 0 with `✓ Codex adapter checks passed (8/8 pass)` and `[✓] Global fallback heartbeat: source=codex session=codex-check-global-1783556532905 entrypoint=global-fallback`.
outcomeDiff: Expected and actual match: the prior missing heartbeat hard failure is gone; actual output includes the codex/global-fallback heartbeat attribution.
limitations: The pre-DONE live smoke used a temporary PATH wrapper pointed at this story worktree build because the installed global lattice binary updates after DONE merge; the worktree build is the same dist output that will be merged.
pitfalls: Do not add .lattice/lattice.json to PROJECT_CONFIG_FILENAMES or make loadConfig parse it as canonical config; that manifest is adapter metadata only.
